task: Fix Windows PATH precedence so a stale global npm shim no longer shadows CodeMie's npm-prefix (installer Add-UserPath and/or shadow detection in commandExists/getCommandPath), EPMCDME-16969.

key_reasoning.reason: Fix site is undecided (installer Add-UserPath vs processes.ts detection vs both). The ticket's 'not installed' symptom does not match first-match shadowing, which would make commandExists true, so reproduction is needed before design.

The closest pattern is isShadowedCodemieShim, which matches one package path and does not cover PATH order. Reordering User PATH has no precedent in the append-only Add-UserPath. A rewrite would hit the deferred %VAR% flattening issue, and Machine PATH precedes User PATH. The installer has no test harness. No existing test template covers PATH-order or multi-match shadow detection.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: no exact precedent for PATH reordering, registry rewrite caveats, and installer untestable by automation
